Priya (PM): Quick sync to finalize the DP recruitment playbook. Need agreement on channels, intake fields, scoring, and graduation gates.
Sam K: Channels = existing customers outreach, community post, select partner network. Add small cold list but tag low priority.
Maria P: Include an async onboarding option for APAC folks + recorded demo. Mention expected time commitment up front (~2 hrs over 6 weeks).
Jonah L: Intake minimal fields: company, contact, role, stack, primary use-case, expected QPS, data sensitivity, success definition. Add optional baseline metrics (latency, tokens/day).
Eli (Growth): Outreach copy: 3-line email, one CTA (schedule or async), A/B subject lines, include short case blurb if we have permission.
Nora S (Legal): Consent checkbox + NDA link mandatory. Add explicit one-line data treatment: "No customer data used for model training without opt-in." Escalate PII/high-sensitivity partners.
Priya (PM): Scoring rubric proposal: product-fit 40%, feasibility 25%, strategic value 20%, legal overhead penalty up to 15%. Capture partner success criteria for prioritization.
Sam K: Compensation: credits first, Dedicated trial second, dev-time only for strategic partners. Check legal on phrasing.
Maria P: Ops: avoid Calendly; use internal scheduler + iCal. Auto-send kickoff packet for async selections.
Jonah L: Telemetry events to add: dp_onboarded, dp_key_used, dp_feedback_submitted, dp_success_metric_update. Hook to DP dashboard.
Eli (Growth): Recommended timeline: 2-week recruitment, 2-week onboarding sprint, 6-week pilot, 1-week analysis = ~11 weeks.
Priya (PM): Graduation gates: >=6 partners live, >=70% onboarded in 14 days, >=10 actionable issues across cohort, at least one opt-in reference, no open critical security blockers.
DesignBot: Uploaded intake template "DP Intake v3" to /assets/DP/forms and scheduled review Wed 9:00 PT.
Priya (PM): Next steps: I'll assemble intake + scoring sheet; Eli will draft A/B emails; Nora will review legal copy; Jonah will add telemetry. Reconvene Wed 9:00 PT to finalize.
